feeds.title: From the Mixed-Up Files
feeds.description: A group blog of middle-grade authors celebrating books for middle-grade readers. Focused on writing and books for 8 to 13 year olds. For anyone with a passion for children's literature - teachers, librarians, parents, kids, writers, industry professionals - we offer regularly updated booklists organized by unique categories, author interviews, market news, and a behind-the-scenes look at the making of children's books from writing to publishing to promoting.

feeds.title: Always in the Middle…
feeds.description: Always in the Middle is a blog about Middle-grade book reviews, giveaways, and writing tips from Greg Pattridge. Discover Middle-grade fiction and non-fiction books to make your kids smarter. Greg runs Always in the Middle and is a teacher, mentor, and writer.

feeds.title: What to Read to Your Kids
feeds.description: Melissa LaSalle, known affectionately as The Book Mommy, resides in Alexandria, Virginia, with her husband and two children. With nearly three decades of expertise in children's literature, she's a beacon of inspiration for fostering literary cultures at home. Through What to Read to Your Kids, Melissa shares her passion for reading, offering unique recommendations across all ages. Her curated selections reflect her unwavering dedication to instilling the love of books in families far and wide.

feeds.title: Bookworm for Kids
feeds.description: Tonja Drecker, the driving force behind Bookworm for Kids, curates a diverse selection of books catering to toddlers, teens, and every age in between. From board books to young adult literature, her platform showcases the latest releases and timeless favourites in children's literature. With a keen eye for quality and variety, Tonja invites readers to explore the enchanting world of picture books, middle-grade adventures, and tween reads, fostering a love of reading across generations.

feeds.description: This is Diya. I am 10, based out of Bangalore and this is my little world on the blogosphere. I love love love reading, practically a book worm but no, I am not a nerd. My other interests are playing the guitar, listening to music, dancing, trying my hand on cooking, traveling and exploring food. I do play a few sports and I enjoy my time outdoors.I would be writing about topics that interest me which I come across in my daily life.
